_doc: reserveMultiplier is the V1 CHAMPION labelled PRIOR, not validated methodology.
(1.25 / 1.50 / 1.75 / a data-derived cutoff) HAS NOW BEEN RUN -- see
scripts/challenge_core_multiplier.py and the lane doc section 16. It rules out
1.25 and places 1.50 inside the defensible band in all four measured formats,
but it does NOT freeze the champion: the data-derived cutoff moves between 1.05
and 1.70 depending purely on where the retention target is drawn, so the
criterion does not uniquely determine M. Status therefore stays PRIOR.
Nothing here self-promotes: champion != challenger, and the script writes
superflexFoldsIntoQb records the OWNER decision (#839 wording) that a Superflex
slot is real QB demand and is added to QB dedicated demand BEFORE the multiplier.
It reproduces the owner's own worked example: 1 QB + 1 SF -> base 2 ->
ceil(1.5 x 2) = 3 meaningful QBs. See the lane doc for the assumption it carries.
